Do you collect and store publisher information from bid requests, and who can access it?

Yes. We store publisher information such as app bundles, root domains and contextual information, from both bid requests and won impressions. It is available to DSP clients as well as to PulsePoint.

Do your proprietary segments use publisher data signals attached to deals, such as age or gender?

For always-on deals, can you return buyer acceptance status after a deal is synced, or sync targeting information?
